objectives.title: Get a first statement on record
objectives.detail: Someone on these streets will talk to a detective with no standing. Knock until a door opens, and take the statement that is offered.

objectives.title: Earn the standing for the doors that stayed shut
objectives.detail: Most of the people on the list will not talk to a stranger. Every statement that helps a neighbor raises your standing, and every interview that goes wrong lowers it. Their gates are on the People page.

objectives.title: Find who made the calls
objectives.detail: A voice, a script and a number. Somebody on the shop row works the floor those calls come from, and asking him costs no statement.

objectives.title: Get the operator to name the floor above him
objectives.detail: He will not give up the floor for nothing. What he answers to is a witness he called: a statement from someone on his floor's list, presented to his face.
objectives.failed_detail: He stopped talking and asked for a lawyer. Nobody else on the floor will name the office above it - unless a witness he called can still be found and brought back to him.

objectives.title: File the case with what it has
objectives.detail: Nobody who made the calls is talking. The office door on Sampaguita Street will take the file as it stands.

objectives.title: Confront the floor director
objectives.detail: The operator named her. Her door is at the far end of the call floor, past the desks - walk the floor before you open it. Two statements from the people her floor called will hold her.

objectives.title: Turn someone who works on the fourth floor
objectives.detail: The floor above the call floor hires by the batch. One of its recruits boards on Terminal Road, at a gate of 65 - and what she answers to is not a badge but someone who read the same advertisement she did.

any.milestone: Her Name Is On The Rack

objectives.title: Name who owns the building
objectives.detail: The floor directors answer to a name on the leases. Whoever runs a whole floor has seen it, and so has whoever closes the calls the floors transfer out. Without the name in the file, the building stands.
